[LFST.10.4] **An event trace carries no version of its own.** The only
version a trace records is the DS version that wrote it, and a runtime accepts
a trace whose recorded version begins with its own `<major>.<minor>.` and
refuses every other ([LDET.1.10]).

A change to what the bytes mean therefore waits for the minor bump, because
recordings made earlier in a series must keep replaying identically within it.
A new inject-class atom is such a change: an older reader cannot skip it
without losing an input it was handed ([RFCS.3.4]).
